evidence.quote: the e2e suite asserts that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer

observations.why: The suite is positioned as an authority that dictates enrollment policy — a test asserting a governance rule enacts authority-ranking by prescribing who must be enrolled.

evidence.quote: This probe memory exists only to carry that assertion

observations.why: Framing the memory as a vehicle whose sole purpose is to carry an authoritative assertion reinforces the same authority-ranking enactment — the probe submits to the suite's governance claim.
